feed_queue.scope: pending includes at most one producer frame in flight; successful send high-water is an upper estimate, not latency

limits: local receive timestamp; no real orders, queue position or market impact; stop/disconnect does not liquidate filled positions

receive_to_durable_ack.method: nearest rank, 32 subdivisions per power of two; integer bucket interval, no sample truncation

batch_wait.method: nearest rank, 32 subdivisions per power of two; integer bucket interval, no sample truncation

commit_per_transaction.method: nearest rank, 32 subdivisions per power of two; integer bucket interval, no sample truncation

queue_wait.method: nearest rank, 32 subdivisions per power of two; integer bucket interval, no sample truncation

receive_to_durable_ack.method: nearest rank, 32 subdivisions per power of two; integer bucket interval, no sample truncation

telemetry.scope: all durably committed quotes including final partial batch; receive is socket-read time, excludes exchange/network/kernel pre-read; commit counts transactions, not quote latencies
telemetry.window_scope: 60s buckets since connection start, assigned by durable ACK time; worst p99 upper bound, sample-count tie-break; current final partial minute included, no fabricated idle samples or coordinated-omission correction
